name: Repository
description: Several agent runs on one small library, read as a code forge shows them: any runs picked or compared issue by issue, pull requests, issues, discussions and agents in tabs filtered on every field, and a pull request's whole story with its commits, diffs, reviews and the file of each entry.

records.name: event
records.one: one opening, push, review, comment, merge, close, reopen, post or sign-off

fields.name: at
fields.from: ts, time, created_at, committed_at or submitted_at
fields.how: in UTC, a time without an offset in the run's timezone

fields.name: hours
fields.how: hours since the run started

fields.name: kind
fields.from: type or event, else the export table
fields.how: push read as commit, pr.merged as merge and so on

fields.name: action
fields.how: opened, pushed, merged and so on, a review by its verdict

fields.name: verdict
fields.how: in lower case, changes_requested as changes requested

records.name: pull request
records.one: one pull request of a run, with its records

fields.name: state
fields.from: its merge, close and reopen records
fields.how: open, merged or closed

fields.name: area
fields.from: labels or area, else the issue it fixes
fields.how: the first label, else the issue's area

fields.name: closes
fields.how: the first number in free text

fields.name: to_merge
fields.how: hours between them

fields.name: first_review
fields.from: its opening and its first review
fields.how: hours between them

fields.name: flags
fields.how: merged by its author, merged over a change request, pushed after its last approval, or waiting for approvals

records.name: issue
records.one: one issue of a run, with its records

fields.name: state
fields.from: its close records and the pull requests that fix it
fields.how: fixed once a pull request that fixes it merged

fields.name: area
fields.how: the first label

fields.name: origin
fields.from: its opening and the run's start
fields.how: backlog when opened before the run started, else found during the run

fields.name: fixed_by
fields.how: the merged pull request that fixes it

fields.name: prs
fields.how: the pull requests that fix it

fields.name: to_fix
fields.from: its opening and the merge that fixed it
fields.how: hours between them

fields.name: elsewhere
fields.how: the same issue in each other run

fields.name: mentions
fields.how: the #<n> numbers they name

fields.name: partners
fields.how: its approvals and change requests per author

fields.name: started
fields.from: the manifest's started, else the first record
fields.how: in UTC

fields.name: hours
fields.how: hours from its start to its last record

fields.name: approvals
fields.how: the first number in free text

accepts.means: the record on line <n> of a run's file, shown in its pull request, issue, discussion or agent, or a manifest's line, which opens its run

units.means: one run: its measures, with the view narrowed to it
one pull request with its commits, reviews, comments and merge or close
one issue with its comments and the pull requests that close it
one discussion, every post in time order
one agent: its note, its activity and its review partners
